_description: Agent-editable signal filters. Updated by SelfLearningLoop after each resolved batch. Commit each change — git log is the learning record.
_last_updated_by: kiro-gap-fix: MILD_BEAR + TRENDING_BEAR regimes added; sector_map expanded to ~120 symbols (RC-007 Oct-1 action item)
_evidence: Sep 28 live session: DRREDDY +1.67% on SHORT (pharma defensive), ASIANPAINT -0.65% on SHORT (paints defensive), MARUTI -0.22% on SHORT (auto defensive). All 3 misses are defensive sectors that rotate up in HIGH_CORR_BEAR regime.

score_threshold._description: Minimum distance from 0.50 neutral to open a position.
score_threshold._note: Set to 0.15 after first threshold_sweep confirms improvement.

reversal_detection._description: ReversalDetector configuration. Reversal signals OVERRIDE momentum when score >= override_threshold AND they contradict momentum direction.
reversal_detection._evidence: Sep 29: ADANIENT RSI=28 + 5 consec down + at lower BB → REVERSAL_LONG → +5.01%. PAYTM RSI=32 + 4 consec down → REVERSAL_LONG → +2.89%. IEX RSI=72 + 4 consec up → REVERSAL_SHORT → -4.45%.
reversal_detection._override_logic: Reversal ONLY overrides momentum when they DISAGREE. When momentum and reversal AGREE, both fire in same direction — higher conviction, no change needed.

sector_regime_filters._description: Sector-specific signal dimmers applied when market regime matches. Multiplier applied to |score - 0.50| conviction before position sizing. 1.0 = no change, 0.0 = fully suppressed.

HIGH_CORR_BEAR._description: Active when NIFTY intraday change < -1.5% — classic risk-off selloff. Defensive sectors rotate UP; shorting them loses.
HIGH_CORR_BEAR._evidence: Sep 28: DRREDDY +1.67%, ASIANPAINT -0.65%, MARUTI -0.22% — all defensive sector longs/neutral in broad selloff.

PHARMA._note: Dim SHORT signals on pharma in HIGH_CORR_BEAR — rotates defensive

PAINTS._note: ASIANPAINT type — defensive in broad selloff

AUTO._note: MARUTI type — auto is defensive relative to cyclicals

PRIVATE_BANK._note: AXISBANK underperformed SHORT expectation — partial dim only

LOW_VOL._description: Low-volatility regime. Momentum signals are weaker; reduce all convictions slightly.

ALL._note: Slight across-the-board reduction in low-vol regimes

MILD_BEAR._description: MILD_BEAR: NIFTY intraday < -0.3% but > -1.5% (below HIGH_CORR_BEAR threshold). Added 2026-10-05 per Oct-1 action item. Defensive sectors still rotate up but with smaller move — use softer dims than HIGH_CORR_BEAR.
MILD_BEAR._evidence: Oct-1 session: NIFTY -0.38% (MILD_BEAR). DRREDDY +0.89%, SUNPHARMA +0.62% (pharma defensive). ASIANPAINT +0.41% (paints defensive). Model was not dimming these in MILD_BEAR → SHORT losses on defensive names.

PHARMA._note: Dim SHORT on pharma in MILD_BEAR (softer than HIGH_CORR_BEAR's 0.2)

PAINTS._note: ASIANPAINT type — partial defensive rotation in mild selloffs

AUTO._note: Auto is partially defensive in mild bear days

FMCG._note: FMCG (ITC, HINDUNILVR) defensive in mild selloffs

TRENDING_BEAR._description: Multi-day downtrend: NIFTY 5d return < -3%. Aggressive risk reduction across all sectors.
TRENDING_BEAR._evidence: Sep 28-Oct 1 sequence: 4-day bear run. Model performed well on SHORTs when trend confirmed, lost on defensive sector SHORTs.

PHARMA._note: Nearly suppress all pharma SHORTs in confirmed downtrend

PAINTS._note: Nearly suppress all paints SHORTs in confirmed downtrend

FMCG._note: FMCG nearly fully defensive in trend-bear

IT._note: IT mildly defensive (USD revenue hedge) in bear trend

symbol_overrides._description: Per-symbol signal overrides. Use sparingly — prefer sector_regime_filters.

TATAMOTORS.reason: DQ-001 RESOLVED (2026-10-05): Angel One token collision fixed (3432→3456). Upstox INE155A01022 is correct regular share ISIN. Transient price discrepancy was a Sep-Oct 2026 CDN issue, not a permanent mapping error. Re-enabled for live scoring.

long_book_limits._description: Maximum LONG positions by regime. Reduces LONG count in bear days to limit beta drag.
long_book_limits._evidence: Sep 28: all 6 LONG positions lost in -1.52% NIFTY day (unhedged market beta).

HIGH_CORR_BEAR._note: Limit LONG to 3 in bear days; rest are FLAT

sector_map._description: NSE F&O symbol → sector classification for regime filters.
